project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite + Tailwind CSS + Supabase (RLS-enforced admin panel)
build_system: Vite 5 with npm scripts. Build command includes prerender step (node scripts/prerender.mjs).
test_framework: No test framework. Verification is via vite build passing.
test_command: No test runner. Use vite build as primary verification.
verification_instructions: Run npx vite build and confirm it completes without errors.
setup_instructions: Node v22 is pre-installed. node_modules already present.
environment_constraints: Open internet access. No Docker needed. Supabase is remote (not local).
contribution_requirements: Build must pass. Branch is feat/full-website.
key_patterns: Admin pages: useState/useEffect pattern with getAdminClient(), sessionCan() for permission gating, AdminNav component at top. Editor pages: useParams for id, form state with EMPTY_ template object, handleSave with insert/update. Permissions: PERMISSION_SECTIONS array in src/lib/permissions.js auto-renders nav links. Routes: lazy imports in App.jsx wrapped with RequirePermission component. Tailwind styling: slate-50 bg, rounded-xl borders, blue-600 primary buttons, divide-y tables. Lucide React icons available.
directory_structure: src/pages/admin/ - all admin page components. src/components/admin/ - shared admin components (AdminNav, RequirePermission, useAdminSession). src/lib/ - utility modules (permissions, adminSession, supabaseAdmin). supabase/ - SQL migration scripts.
